description: This file is a React component for the dashboard homepage of a blog platform, allowing users to view, create, publish/unpublish, and delete their posts. It manages state for post list, loading status, and post creation process, and interacts with hooks and utilities for post operations.

methods.name: humanDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to a localized date string, with fallback to original string.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new post with a unique slug, then navigates to the editor for the new post.

methods.name: onTogglePublish
methods.description: Toggles the publish status of a post (publish or unpublish).

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified post after user confirmation.
